subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` permanently apply only to the built-in OpenClaw harness and reject configured Codex/plugin-harness runs, or must merge wait for a generic harness capability contract?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes an earlier cross-harness design into a built-in-only public setting; source inspection and the Codex app-server contract show that equivalent pre-execution enforcement is not uniformly available, so the permanent product boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Bless built-in-only enforcement
options.body: Keep the documented opt-in setting, retain preflight rejection for plugin harnesses, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Add a harness capability contract
options.body: Pause merge until harnesses can advertise and implement equivalent round-limit semantics through a stable generic interface.

options.title: Defer the config surface
options.body: Remove the public option and keep the canonical issue open until a cross-runtime policy is ready.

recommendation.title: Bless built-in-only enforcement
recommendation.body: Keep the documented opt-in setting, retain preflight rejection for plugin harnesses, and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They shaped the current one-key contract and integrated the latest runtime and package-boundary implementation.
